subject.title: refactor(chat-ui): render iOS tool calls as flat expandable rows

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this flat expandable tool-activity presentation as the shared iOS/macOS chat UX?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the user-facing native chat information hierarchy across two apps, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human approval even though the proposed implementation is focused.

options.title: Approve after native validation
options.body: Accept the shared presentation once the iOS/macOS checks complete successfully and the visual hierarchy matches maintainer expectations.

options.title: Request targeted UX adjustments
options.body: Keep the shared row architecture but request specific accessibility, density, or expansion-behavior refinements before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve after native validation
recommendation.body: Accept the shared presentation once the iOS/macOS checks complete successfully and the visual hierarchy matches maintainer expectations.
